sentences.text:
For Respondent Nos.1-3: Ms. Shivani Kapoor, A.C to S.C-II -----
12/14.02.2023

A supplementary counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent Nos. 1 to 3 stating inter alia that earlier notification issued under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 [hereinafter referred to as 'the Act, 2013'] was published in the extraordinary edition of Ranchi District Gazette vide Gazette No. 30 dated 09.07.2018.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It has further been stated that the said notification was also published in the daily newspaper as per the documents available in the record.
A copy of the advertisement preview details has been annexed as Annexure-E to the said supplementary counter affidavit.

Mr. Abhay Prakash, learned counsel for the petitioners, while referring to the provisions of Section 11 of the Act, 2013, submits that after publishing the notification in official gazette under Section 11(1)(a) of the Act, 2013, the mandatory requirement under Section 11(1)(b) is to publish the same in two daily newspapers having circulation in the locality of such area in which one shall be in regional language.
The said respondents however have not annexed copies of the newspaper cuttings so as to show compliance of the provisions of Section 11(1)(b) of the Act, 2013.

On this, Ms. Shivani Kapoor, learned A.C to S.C-II appearing on behalf of the respondent Nos. 1 to 3,
prays for two weeks' time to file a supplementary counter affidavit bringing on record the copies of the newspaper cuttings showing compliance of the provisions of Section 11(1)(b) of the Act, 2013.
In view of the said prayer, put up this case on 06.03.2023 under the same heading.
